ctl.signIn.title.description: Heading of the Nexus Control sign-in page; {product} is the product name.

ctl.signIn.intro.message: Demo: pick a staff member to see Nexus Control with their roles. Real sign-in uses staff single sign-on with multi-factor login.
ctl.signIn.intro.description: Text under the sign-in heading in the demo, explaining the staff picker.

ctl.signIn.as.description: Accessible label of a button that signs in as a demo staff member; {name} is their name.

ctl.signIn.noStaff.description: Shown on the sign-in page when the demo staff list is empty.

ctl.role.superAdmin.description: Provider staff role: full access to Nexus Control (never to institution data).

ctl.role.sales.description: Provider staff role: sales and account management.

ctl.role.billing.description: Provider staff role: invoices, payments and subscriptions.

ctl.role.support.description: Provider staff role: support desk agent.

ctl.role.implementation.description: Provider staff role: onboarding, installs and data moves.

ctl.role.releaseManager.description: Provider staff role: releases, channels and extensions.

ctl.role.sre.description: Provider staff role: site reliability engineer who runs the fleet.

ctl.role.securityOfficer.description: Provider staff role: security, compliance and staff access.

ctl.role.partner.description: Role of a reseller partner's user, who sees only the accounts their partner manages.

ctl.home.intro.message: Run customers, licences, releases and support. Nexus Control holds business and technical records only — never an institution's learners, families or staff.
ctl.home.intro.description: Intro line on the Nexus Control home page; explains that it never holds institution data.

ctl.home.noModulesBody.message: Pages for your roles appear here as they are added.
ctl.home.noModulesBody.description: Shown on the Nexus Control home page when no page is available for the staff member's roles.

ctl.shell.rolesLabel.description: Under the staff member's name in the header; {roles} is a comma-separated list of role names.

ctl.shell.mfaVerified.description: Accessible label of the shield icon next to the staff name; every staff session uses multi-factor login.

p01.nav.description: Menu item and page title of the customer accounts page (P01).

p01.summary.description: One-line description on the Accounts home tile.

p01.list.caption.description: Accessible caption of the accounts table.

p01.list.search.description: Label of the search box that filters accounts by name.

p01.list.filterStage.description: Label of the filter for the account stage (lead, trial, customer, churned).

p01.list.filterModel.description: Label of the filter for how the customer runs NexusCampus (SaaS or self-hosted).

p01.list.all.description: Filter option that shows every value.

p01.list.empty.description: Shown when no account matches the search and filters.

p01.col.type.description: Column header: institution type of the customer.

p01.col.learners.description: Column header: number of learners (a count, never names).

p01.col.health.description: Column header: account health score from 0 to 100.

p01.stage.trial.description: Account stage: on a free trial.

p01.model.saasShared.description: Delivery model: our shared cloud cell.

p01.model.saasDedicated.description: Delivery model: a cloud cell only for this customer.

p01.model.selfHosted.description: Delivery model: runs on the customer's own servers.

p01.model.hybrid.description: Delivery model: SaaS or self-hosted plus an on-campus Edge node.

p01.health.score.description: Health cell: the score and its label, e.g. 82 · Healthy.

p01.health.good.description: Health label for a score of 70 or more.

p01.health.watch.description: Health label for a score from 50 to 69.

p01.health.risk.description: Health label for a score below 50.

p01.none.description: Shown in a cell that has no value.

p01.detail.back.description: Link back from an account to the list.

p01.detail.summary.description: Heading of the account summary card.

p01.detail.region.description: Label: the region where the customer's data is stored.

p01.detail.owner.description: Label: the staff member who owns the account.

p01.detail.partner.description: Label: the reseller partner who manages the account.

p01.detail.direct.description: Shown when no partner manages the account.

p01.detail.tenants.description: Label: how many tenants we run for this customer.

p01.detail.since.description: Label: when the account was created.

p01.detail.notFound.message: This account does not exist or you cannot see it.
p01.detail.notFound.description: Shown when an account id is unknown or belongs to another partner.

p01.tabs.label.description: Accessible label of the account tabs.

p01.tab.notes.description: Tab: internal notes about the account.

p01.contacts.caption.description: Accessible caption of the contacts table.

p01.contacts.email.description: Column header: work email of a customer contact.

p01.contacts.phone.description: Column header: phone of a customer contact.

p01.contacts.kind.description: Column header: contact role (billing, technical, executive, data protection).

p01.contactKind.dpo.description: Contact role: the customer's data protection officer.

p01.opps.caption.description: Accessible caption of the opportunities table.

p01.contracts.caption.description: Accessible caption of the contracts table.

p01.contracts.term.description: Column header: contract start and end.

p01.contracts.termRange.description: Contract term: start date to end date.

p01.contracts.perpetual.description: Contract term of a perpetual licence.

p01.contractKind.licencePerpetual.description: Contract kind: self-hosted licence without an end date.

p01.contractKind.licenceTerm.description: Contract kind: self-hosted licence for a fixed period.

p01.contractKind.support.description: Contract kind: support and update contract.

p01.notes.label.description: Label of the box for a new internal note about the account.

p01.notes.hint.message: Business notes only — never personal details of the institution's people.
p01.notes.hint.description: Help text under the note box (privacy rule V-7).

p01.notes.add.description: Button that saves a new note.

p01.notes.added.description: Toast after a note is saved.

p01.notes.failed.message: The note was not saved. Try again.
p01.notes.failed.description: Toast when saving a note fails.

p01.notes.empty.description: Shown when an account has no notes.

p01.notes.byline.description: Under a note: who wrote it and when.

p01.notes.readOnly.message: You can read notes but not add them.
p01.notes.readOnly.description: Shown instead of the note form without permission to add notes.
